Mutant Feature - Feathered Wings.name: Mutant Feature - Feathered Wings
Mutant Feature - Feathered Wings.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Feathered Wings
A pair of large feathered wings growing from the shoulder blades.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Feathered Wings.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual only: a permanent Mutant body feature; keep it in every portrait, even with an Emitter or Transformation Quirk Type. Adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two features for one body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the alphabetically first. Quirkless or No Quirk: no heteromorph body; do not draw it.

Portrait: a pair of large feathered wings grows from the shoulder blades through openings in the clothing. Folded, they lie along the back with the long flight feathers reaching the backs of the knees; spread, they span more than the character's height. Short layered coverts run along the top edge above the flight feathers. Feathers follow the selected hair color, with paler undersides. Keep them folded unless the selected pose spreads them.
